description: "Poems, 1799" by Robert Southey is a collection of poetry written during the late 18th century. The poems encompass various themes, notably the exploration of spiritual and moral dilemmas, often depicted through the historical figure of Joan of Arc, as well as reflections on social issues and human experiences.
